_comment: Example llmt-router policy (fictional runners). router.json: "policy_file": "/etc/allrunner/router-policy.json" + "session_policy": {"on": true}. tiers: X-Priority names, rank 0 = most urgent; vllm_priority goes to engines with priority_sched; cache = the RAM tier's value class (normal / low / lowest; low classes are still cached, they only go first under room pressure); background = never takes a GPU with more agent work than another, may wait (low_wait_s). rules: first match on X-Agent-Name (globs) and X-Agent (roles); retention session / group / oneshot / lowest; terminal_roles end a session's retention; place session (always first) then group / parent; group name / name+session. Re-read when it changes.
